statement: Legacy administrative ACTIVE models lacking Gate 6 eligibility are strictly denied advisory authority, failing closed to SKIP under FAIL_CLOSED_SKIP and proceeding unfiltered under ALLOW_UNFILTERED.

Proper scoring rules require training-only class prevalence baseline forecast evaluated on chronological OOS holdout with positive Brier Skill Score (BSS > 0) for champion promotion and challenger replacement.
Full Gate 6 validation funnel enforces training >= 300, OOS >= 100, SHADOW >= 100, challenger days >= 14, operations >= 50, Brier <= 0.28, ECE <= 0.15, and drawdown limits.
